[USER] Explain what a mutex is in one paragraph.
[ASSISTANT] A mutex is a lock that only one thread can hold at a time. A thread takes the lock before touching shared data and releases it afterwards, so two threads never modify the same data at once. If a thread forgets to release it, every other thread waiting on it stalls.<|endoftext|>
